formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Ansel is sqrt(2) tiles from both opening Melantha and Friston, outside the 1.2 blast radius when a shell locks on Ansel. Steward is sqrt(10) tiles from Ansel. Hibiscus and Steward are adjacent and can share a shell; this exposure is deliberate and remains the principal survival uncertainty.
formation_structure.damage_chain: Beagle frees Melantha to return at 4141. Melantha supplies lower central finishing damage while Midnight supplies upper armor arts. Steward remains deployed through 7000, avoiding V2's 4275-6375 damage gap.
formation_structure.economy: Current simulator source confirms voluntary retreat refunds floor(paid deployment cost/2). Credit exactly 7 DP for Melantha's live retreat at 2010, enabling Steward at 2011. Credit only Fang's survival-dependent grants at 570, 1320 and 2070. Checked post-deployment balances are 0.033 at 2011, 15.033 at 2821 and 44.033 at 4141; later clearance needs no additional refunds or skill income.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Read-only range checks confirm both principal medics cover Fang, Friston, each other and Steward. Ansel normally misses Midnight; his supported forward extension adds Midnight's [1,5] during each scheduled skill. Neither medic covers Beagle or either Melantha position.
formation_structure.opening_without_global_rescue: The revised geometry removes the former Ansel-centered collateral dependency on Lancet's 200 heal. Saved pre-shell damage to opening Melantha totaled 1600; 2745-1600-845=300 supports one isolated shell before retreat, conditionally. It does not support a second shell or guarantee changed targeting.
formation_structure.recovery_replacement: Ansel's first extended range window is 2642-3392, before and during the second artillery pressure interval. Later windows restore Midnight between outer officer groups. Healing remains autonomous.
formation_structure.roster_revision: Remove Lancet and restore Beagle. No ninth operator, alias or substitute is authorized.
formation_structure.verification_scope: Read-only checks passed legality, eight-ID union, tiles, range geometry, DP affordability, first skill readiness, repeated skill spacing and redeployment intervals. No stage simulation was run.

tactical_thesis: Replace Lancet with reciprocal principal-medic coverage and periodic Ansel recovery of Midnight. Restore Beagle's lower-outer handoff and Melantha's protected central damage. Move Ansel to [5,6] DOWN and Steward to [2,7] UP; retain Steward through late approach pressure. This eight-operator hypothesis removes the previous caster redeployment gap while explicitly testing the new shared artillery exposure.
